messages:
Sophia C: Quick heads-up — tessera-v1 int8 bring-up showing locale-specific regressions for zh/ja and mixed RTL. BLEU down ~6–8 pts on our newswire subset; pattern involves em-dash + ZWSP/NBSP + emoji.
Andre K: can you paste minimal repros? :eyes: 
Sophia C: example:
```
Input: "会议—​这是测试 😊"
FP16 decode: "会议 — ​这是测试 😊"
INT8 decode: "会议这是 😊"    <-- em-dash collapsed into neighbor, zwsp lost, spacing moved
```
Yuki N: looks like tokenization boundary changes. did the preprocessing spm bump go into the int8 build?
Sophia C: yes — the int8 pipeline used the updated sentencepiece (v0.1.98) preprocessor. fp16 uses v0.1.95.
Kevin L: try decoding int8 weights with the older spm model (keep fp16 spm) to isolate tokenizer vs quant effects.
Sophia C: did that: keeping old spm reduces failures by ~70%. BLEU delta on subset goes from -7.1 -> -1.0.
ml-bot: EVAL SNAPSHOT (thread 1742109999): tessera-v1 fp16 vs int8 subset
```
metric | fp16 | int8 | delta
BLEU   | 29.2 | 22.1 | -7.1
BLEU (old-spm) | 29.2 | 28.2 | -1.0
CER    | 11.8 | 17.6 | +5.8
```
Andre K: that strongly implicates normalization differences in the new spm. check trainer_spec.normalization_rule_name and the compiled normalizer package.
Yuki N: I inspected the spm normalizer: v0.1.98 defaulted to NFKC-ish rules for punctuation and collapsed U+2014 into adjacent tokens in certain contexts. older kept em-dash as separate token.
Sophia C: token dumps show missing em-dash token in new spm:
```
old-spm tokens: [0x1f4, 0x0a5, 0x2014, 0x6a3, ...]
new-spm tokens: [0x1f4, 0x0a5, 0x6a3, ...]  # em-dash gone
```
Kevin L: plan: 1) pin sentencepiece version in int8 build artifacts; 2) add normalization smoke tests covering ZWSP/ZWJ, EM DASH, NBSP, HAIR SPACE, emoji; 3) token-level diff harness in CI.
Sophia C: started a bisect across spm commits + quant kernel variants. prioritizing tokenizer pin since old-spm mitigates most failures.
ops-bot: Canary queued: tessera-v1-int8-spm-pin on staging-gpu-2, ETA ~14m.
Andre K: if pin fixes, add a blocking CI rule: any spm bump needs explicit compatibility flag and locale smoke green.
Yuki N: I'll add narrow NBSP and mixed-direction bracket cases to the smoke set and a tiny unit that asserts token id for EM DASH remains stable.
Sophia C: TL;DR — root cause: sentencepiece normalization change in v0.1.98 that collapses em-dash/ZWSP in some contexts, surfacing as BLEU/CER regression after quantization. Mitigation: pin spm, add locale-focused normalization tests, canary. Opening PR with bisect artifacts and test vectors.
Andre K: thanks — ping on PR, will help wire the CI guard. :thumbsup:
